description: First attempt at orderer-delay attack injection via pumba on 5-orderer Raft cluster. Pumba container exited with 'duration must be shorter than interval' error before injecting any delay; all three labelled phases (clean/+200ms/+500ms) ran on effectively undelayed network.
pumba_error_caught: time="2026-06-07T14:14:59Z" level=fatal msg="error parsing netem parameters: duration must be shorter than interval"
diagnosis: Used --interval 4m --duration 4m; pumba requires interval > duration. Fixed in re-run by using --interval 10m --duration 4m.
observation_confirming_void: TPS across clean/+200ms/+500ms phases at C=16: 44.14 / 51.22 / 50.52 — all WITHIN clean baseline variance, indicating no actual delay was injected
valid_rerun: 5node_attack_2026-06-07/ contains the valid epsilon-phase data with correctly applied pumba delay

paper_integration.paper_table_label: (not in paper - invalidated by pumba syntax error)

related_phases.epsilon: 5node_attack_2026-06-07 (the valid re-run with corrected pumba interval > duration syntax)
